video.title: Zero config eBPF & AI root cause observability with coroot! #observability

transcript.text: Most outages are not hard to fix. The
real problem is figuring out what went
wrong. In incident response, engineers
lose most of the time switching between
metrics, logs, traces, dashboard, and
still not knowing the actual root cause.
A good observability should instantly
show you what broke, where it broke, and
why without deep manual digging. And
that's exactly what Coror Routt actually
does. Corroot uses zero config ebpf to
automatically capture system behavior
from the kernel. No agents, no code
changes. It also builds a real-time map
of all your services, correlating
metrics, logs, traces, and profile to
show you exactly when and where an
started. And with AI powered root cause
analysis, Coror Root can explain the
incident and give you suggested fixes in
just minutes. So if you want to explore
it, check out the Core Routt opensource
community edition or check out the
enterprise version with unlimited AI
root cause analysis just for $1 per CPU
core. The link is in the pin comment.
